item.title: Ant Group Open-Sources Ling-3.2-air Native Multimodal Model with 124B Parameters
item.description:
Ant Group has released and open-sourced Ling-3.2-air, a native multimodal model accepting text, image and video inputs with 124B total parameters and 5.5B activated per token. Versus its predecessor Ling-3.0-flash-VL, it improves across language reasoning, coding, agentic execution and multimodal tasks, with SWE-bench Pro jumping from 26.40 to 58.28 and AutomationBench-AA rising from 15.7% to 61%. Weights are available on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

原文标题：蚂蚁开源 Ling-3.2-air 原生多模态模型 总参数 1240 亿

Why it matters：国产开源原生多模态模型在代码仓库与智能体工作流上大幅跃升，权重同步开放，值得关注。

item.title: Ant Group's OceanBase Launches Lake-Warehouse AI Data Platform and Open-Sources Core Engine
item.description:
Ant Group's OceanBase unveiled OceanLake, a lake-warehouse integrated AI data platform, at its Beijing AI Data Conference on November 24, and announced it will open-source the core AI database engine globally. CEO Yang Bing framed data as the ultimate bottleneck once models and agent infrastructure mature, laying out four principles: lake-warehouse unification, multi-model fusion, agent-friendliness, and open source.

原文标题：OceanBase 发布湖库一体 AI 数据平台并开源核心引擎

Why it matters：国产数据库厂商将核心引擎开源并明确押注 Agent 数据层，是数据基础设施赛道值得关注的路线信号。

item.title: Zhihu Gains Indirect DeepSeek Stake as Shares Jump 10 Percent
item.description:
Zhihu disclosed an indirect, low-single-digit percentage stake in DeepSeek through a fund it backs, sending its Hong Kong shares up 10% and its US shares up about 15.76%. DeepSeek's latest round raised roughly RMB 100-105.5 billion at a post-money valuation of about RMB 615.5 billion, bringing cumulative funding past RMB 150 billion while founder Liang Wenfeng retains control with about 67.42% ownership.

原文标题：知乎间接入股 DeepSeek 股价大涨 10%

Why it matters：DeepSeek 千亿级融资与估值细节首次具体披露，是观察中国大模型资本格局的关键事件。

item.title: mcpseal Grades MCP Servers A to F Before Installation
item.description:
A developer released mcpseal, a static-analysis tool that grades any MCP server package A-F before installation, flagging install scripts, credential-file access, dynamic code, shell usage and webhook exfiltration patterns. It runs via npx and can generate a README badge for authors, though it explicitly cannot prove a package is safe.

原文标题：mcpseal 上线 安装前为 MCP 服务器做 A-F 安全评级

Why it matters：MCP 生态快速扩张，安装前安全审查成为真实痛点，该工具提供了轻量可用的第一道防线。

item.title: Juncts Unifies Five Social DM Inboxes into One App
item.description:
Juncts launched a unified DM inbox that aggregates LinkedIn, X, Instagram, WhatsApp and Telegram messages into a single interface, claiming Claude and ChatGPT can operate within it. The product is currently available as a demo, with no details disclosed on implementation, model integration or pricing.

item.title: HarmonyOS Device Installs Surpass 100 Million as Developer Base Hits 12 Million
item.description:
Huawei said combined installs of HarmonyOS 5/6/7 across phones, tablets and PCs have passed 100 million, with more than 460,000 apps and services available and over 12 million registered developers, marking a scale tipping point for the ecosystem. OpenHarmony now counts 14,000+ contributors and 120+ industry distributions deployed in power, water and industrial settings, while the system-level AI assistant Xiaoyi can call 2,100+ system capabilities and 500+ partner Skills.

item.title: Anthropic Opens Zero Data Retention Beta with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards
item.description:
Anthropic has moved Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) into beta, pairing advanced misuse detection with zero data retention so that neither Anthropic nor cloud providers store enterprise data. The program was refined with over 100 customers, including a quarter of the Fortune 100, with Bridgewater, Salesforce and Stripe among private beta evaluators.

item.title: ByteDance's Doubao Launches Xiaodou AI Personal Assistant in Invite-Only Beta
item.description:
Doubao has opened an invite-only public beta of Xiaodou, its AI personal assistant, offering invitees free usage credits. Xiaodou handles everyday tasks such as information lookup, scheduling, local services, order and after-sales support, health reminders and office assistance through conversational interaction within user authorization, with capabilities set to roll into the Doubao app over time.

item.title: China Digital Industry Revenue Hits 32.41 Trillion Yuan as Smart Compute Surges 146%
item.description:
China's digital industry posted 32.41 trillion yuan in revenue and 2.78 trillion yuan in profit for the first three quarters, up 14.8% and 23.4% year on year, with generative AI adoption exceeding 50%. Smart compute capacity reached 2,592 EFLOPS, up 146% year on year, as infrastructure buildout and AI hardware demand drove growth.

item.title: Huawei Opens Preorders for Weigan G1 Glucose Monitoring System
item.description:
Huawei opened preorders on November 24 for its Weigan G1 continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system, which offers round-the-clock glucose tracking, multi-device viewing on phones and watches, and abnormal-glucose alerts. The device received China's Class III medical device registration on October 30, marking Huawei's move from Class II health-monitoring clearances into clinical-grade continuous monitoring.

Why it matters：华为首款三类医疗器械级 CGM 产品落地，是消费电子巨头切入临床级健康监测的重要信号。

item.title: Microsoft Exec Says AI Cuts 90% of Manual Coding Work
item.description:
Microsoft EVP Charles Lamanna said in an interview that AI is shifting engineers away from line-by-line coding toward system design, validation, testing and secure deployment, cutting manual code writing by roughly 90%. He also predicted agents will become primary software users, pushing APIs toward performance and programmability, while Copilot will not replace fine-grained editing in Office apps.

原文标题：微软高管称 AI 让程序员少写 90% 代码

Why it matters：微软核心高管对 AI 重塑编程工作方式给出明确判断，涉及智能体作为软件主要使用者的产品方向，值得关注。

item.title: Developer Uses Claude to Turn a Dumb TV Smart
item.description:
A developer used Claude to script control of an old, non-networked TV connected to a desktop via HDMI, enabling playback and window management from the TV remote. The author notes Claude occasionally went off track or left obvious bugs, but still saved enough time to justify going beyond the original scope.

item.title: Shenzhen Forms China's First AI Industry Insurance Consortium
item.description:
Thirteen property insurers in Shenzhen's Futian District have jointly launched China's first AI industry insurance consortium, aiming to solve the underwriting gap that leaves large-model supply chains largely uninsurable. The accompanying 2026 AI Industry Risk Governance White Paper maps risk across the compute-model-application chain and seeks to turn systemic AI risk into insurable, priceable products.

原文标题：深圳成立全国首个 AI 产业保险共同体

Why it matters：这是国内首个面向 AI 全产业链的保险共保机制，为 AI 企业风险转移与商业化落地提供了新的金融基础设施样本。

item.title: Rune Project Rebuilds Emacs Core in Rust with Multithreaded Elisp
item.description:
Rune is an experimental Emacs core written in Rust, aiming to bring multithreaded Elisp to Emacs, stay bug-compatible with existing Elisp packages, and leverage the Rust ecosystem for faster GC, regex, and JSON. The project is at a very early stage, with a basic Elisp runtime in place and work underway on a minimal GUI editor MVP covering buffers, cursors, scrolling, and file IO.

原文标题：Rust 重写 Emacs 内核 支持多线程 Elisp

Why it matters：以 Rust 重写 Emacs 内核并追求多线程 Elisp 与包级兼容，是编辑器基础设施领域值得关注的开源实验。

item.title: Ainos Wins $9M Follow-On Order to Deploy AI Nose in Chip Fabs
item.description:
Scent-sensing company Ainos signed a $9M follow-on order with ASE, adding 5,000 AI Nose systems for a cumulative 6,400 units and $11.1M in contracts. The system converts airborne chemical signatures into trainable digital Smell IDs at ppb-level sensitivity, targeting leak, cable-overheating and equipment-anomaly detection in semiconductor fabs. Ainos says it has amassed over 3 billion real-world chemical data points and is exploring olfactory capabilities for mobile and quadruped robots.

原文标题：Ainos 获 900 万美元追加订单 电子鼻进驻芯片工厂

Why it matters：AI 感知从视觉听觉扩展到嗅觉并在半导体制造场景落地，是具身智能与工业 AI 值得关注的增量方向。

item.title: Anthropic Lets Enterprise Customers Store Model Logs Under Own Keys
item.description:
Anthropic now lets enterprise customers running its Mythos and Fable models store prompts and responses in their own cloud environments under their own encryption keys instead of Anthropic-hosted storage. The 30-day retention requirement remains to enable cross-session misuse detection, with Anthropic software scanning the stored data in 15-minute windows for signs of advanced attacks.

原文标题：Anthropic 允许企业客户自持密钥存储模型日志

Why it matters：这是企业级 AI 数据主权与安全合规的重要让步，兼顾滥用检测与客户密钥控制。

item.title: 41 State AGs Challenge Character.AI Bankruptcy Sale Over Child Data
item.description:
Attorneys general from 41 US states and Washington DC have jointly challenged Character.AI's bankruptcy sale, arguing the deal imposes no obligations on the buyer, who could ignore privacy policies and deletion requests and freely resell user data, while the sole bidder Smirks and Pangs remains opaque. The coalition asks the court to reject the terms and at minimum exclude children's chat logs and other sensitive data from any sale.

原文标题：41 州总检察长反对 Character.AI 破产出售条款

Why it matters：这是 AI 聊天平台用户数据在资产出售中如何处置的首个高规格监管案例，对数据合规与平台治理有直接参考价值。

item.title: Microsoft Teams to Add AI Scam Detection for Calls
item.description:
Microsoft is planning an AI anti-scam feature for one-on-one external Teams calls that analyzes conversation content and warns users when it detects voice phishing signals such as impersonated IT administrators. The feature is on the roadmap for general availability in January 2027, though Microsoft has not said whether analysis runs on-device or in the cloud.

原文标题：微软 Teams 将引入 AI 防诈骗功能

Why it matters：这是 Teams 在既有垃圾来电防护之上新增的实时通话内容分析能力，属于有明确产品方向的企业通信安全更新。

item.title: OpenRouter Removes Three Providers After Prompt and Key Leaks
item.description:
OpenRouter has removed Together AI, Phala and Novita from its platform and revoked zero-data-retention status for 125 endpoints after downstream prompt and credential leaks. Security firm Dragos traced the exposure using nearly 2 million tagged test prompts, with leaked credentials later used against controlled test systems and AWS accounts. OpenRouter says its own systems were not breached, highlighting audit gaps in aggregated API data-handling promises and the need for affected users to rotate keys.

原文标题：OpenRouter 清退 3 家服务商 125 个端点失去零保留资格

Why it matters：全球最大 API 聚合平台首次大规模清退违规服务商，直接触及 AI 调用链路的数据安全与信任边界。

item.title: Ant Group Open-Sources LingSante-Pulse Physiological Signal Foundation Model
item.description:
Ant Group has open-sourced LingSante-Pulse on HuggingFace, a general-purpose physiological foundation model that routes heart, brain, pulse and muscle signals through one shared 12-layer Transformer encoder, achieving the best dataset-balanced mean rank across four signal domains in 38 task configurations. Pretraining aligns simultaneously recorded signals, reconstructs masked waveform segments and predicts randomly generated rhythm and timing measurements, ending the prior need for a dedicated model per signal type.

原文标题：蚂蚁集团开源 LingSante-Pulse 生理信号基础模型

Why it matters：开源权重加单编码器统一四类生理信号并全面超越专用模型，是生理信号基础模型方向值得关注的实质进展。

item.title: Samsung Memory Capacity Sold Out Through 2029 as Buyers Seek 2031 Supply
item.description:
Samsung has allocated most of its memory manufacturing capacity for 2027 through 2029 via long-term supply agreements, with some customers now pushing contracts out to 2031, potentially involving prepayments and contractual pricing. HBM production is absorbing large volumes of DRAM wafers, and major memory makers can currently meet only about 60-70% of customer demand, with the shortfall likely widening in 2027.

原文标题：三星 2029 年存储产能近售罄 客户抢订 2031 年

Why it matters：存储产能被提前锁定至 2029 年乃至 2031 年，是 AI 算力扩张向供应链上游传导的关键信号。

item.title: 饮酒削弱免疫疗法效果 阻断 TIGIT 可逆转
item.description:
研究发现，长期饮酒会损害小鼠对膀胱癌和肺癌免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）的应答，并在肺癌患者队列中与生存获益下降相关。机制上，饮酒上调免疫检查点分子 TIGIT，联合阻断 TIGIT 可恢复小鼠对已获批 PD-1 抑制剂的反应，提示患者饮酒史应纳入免疫治疗策略考量。

Why it matters：首次将饮酒史与免疫检查点抑制剂疗效下降建立机制关联，并给出 TIGIT 联合阻断的可操作逆转路径，对肿瘤免疫治疗与临床决策有直接价值。

item.title: GPT-6.2 Sol 登陆 ChatGPT 并优化联网检索

item.title: 前 10 月数据服务业用电增速超 40% 算力需求旺盛
item.description:
国家能源局数据显示，今年前 10 个月全社会用电量同比增长 3.7%，其中互联网等数据服务业用电量达 892 亿千瓦时，同比增速 40.8%，成为用电增长新引擎。贵安新区数据中心用电量同比增长 41.37%，贵州算力中智算占比高达 98%，反映算力基础设施扩张对电力系统的实质拉动。

Why it matters：用电数据是观察算力基础设施扩张的硬指标，40% 以上的数据服务业用电增速直接印证 AI 数据中心规模落地。

item.description:

item.title: 三星西安工厂升级 V9 闪存 扩产 AI 数据中心 eSSD
item.description:
三星计划将西安工厂打造为面向 AI 数据中心的 eSSD 核心生产基地，重点扩大第九代 V9 NAND 产能。改造完成后 V9 月产能预计达 5 万至 6 万片，设备 2027 年 2 月进场、同年 11 月完成。V9 采用 286 层堆叠，容量较上代提升约 50%，良率已超 90%。

Why it matters：头部存储厂商在华产能向 AI 数据中心 eSSD 倾斜，直接影响 NAND 供需与算力基础设施成本。

item.title: OpenAI 与思科开源 Shirudo 实现免重启漏洞防护
item.description:
OpenAI 与思科联合开源安全运行时 Shirudo，基于 eBPF 技术在内核层为运行中的 Linux 系统动态加载临时防护，无需重启即可阻断漏洞利用。在受控测试中，由 Codex 生成的防护层成功拦截针对 Elasticsearch 的 Java4Shell 攻击，且服务全程未中断。项目以 BSD 2-Clause 许可证开源，并引入签名验证与 TPM 审计机制以降低误用风险。

Why it matters：OpenAI 与思科联手将 eBPF 运行时防护开源，为漏洞应急响应提供了免重启的工程化新范式。
